purpose: Defines the first US search-launch slice without enabling indexing. A product can enter this slice only when its model identity, placement, capacity, exterior dimensions, materials and core electrical values are tied to an exact manufacturer page.
remaining_gates: Complete the operator review of the US contact, methodology, affiliate disclosure and privacy pages before changing their publication status.
Promote only the reviewed first-wave products and configurations to published in a separate release.
Enable indexing only after the publication-state, sitemap, robots, structured-data and live-device checks pass for the exact release snapshot.
commercial_scope: Affiliate approval and image rights are separate gates. They do not prevent a source-based, image-free editorial launch, but no US offer, tracking link, price or manufacturer image may appear before its own approval is documented.
